deviceVerification.entry: Install the APK on an arm64 Android device, grant VpnService consent, select the Rust engine and toggle connect; then switch to Mihomo and back.
mustRecord: device model, Android version, APK build
engine identity line (instance/version) and process PID
TCP/UDP/DNS marked traffic for each engine and each switch direction
fd release after disconnect/revoke (no leaked descriptor or flow)
fallback to Mihomo and the readable failure reason when the Rust target fails
disconnect/engine switch stops the Rust child before the host ParcelFileDescriptor closes; the fd loss (revoke) exits the CLI non-zero within the host sampling window
deviceVerification.notClaimed: Android two-way engine switching with real traffic has NOT been verified; only host-level fd tests and wiring are green.

knownLimits: The shared T7 stack answers DNS on :53 via the configured resolver and drops ICMP by name; it is not a full Android kernel network stack.
The fd pump assumes a packet-oriented descriptor (VpnService TUN). A host that supplies a stream socket must frame packets itself.
The Android process route inherits the fd via FD_CLOEXEC clearing; an in-process embedder calling billow_android_vpn_start must also clear FD_CLOEXEC before the call or pass an owned descriptor.

The host has no direct revoke callback: Kotlin reports fd -1, the child exits on fd loss, and the host notices the dead data plane on a later process-liveness sample; on-device confirmation is pending.

A desktop Rust session does not take over a TUN device (tun is stripped for Engine::Rust on every platform; desktop TUN belongs to T6/Mihomo), so it serves the mixed listener only and must not be read as desktop Rust TUN support.

blockedFindings.summary: 无变化的 app 分流保存会杀掉 Android Rust 子进程且不重建：set_app_rules 在判断过滤是否变化前就 stop_android_rust_kernel，takeover 返回 None 后既不 establish 也不 reload；stop() 清空 exit_detail 使 recover_crashed_kernel 无法自愈
blockedFindings.fix: 停止动作下沉到 refresh_vpn 的 before_replace 回调（takeover::set_app_rules/exclude_package/include_package），只有确定替换 fd 时才停子进程
blockedFindings.regression: android_rust_noop_app_rule_saves_keep_the_child_and_tunnel；在旧顺序下该用例失败（a no-op save must not kill the child），修复后通过

blockedFindings.summary: stop_android_rust_kernel 的 set_tun_fd(None) 位于 running() 判断内，子进程已退出时旧 fd 号残留
blockedFindings.fix: set_tun_fd(None) 在 running() 之外执行，仅在有存活子进程时 stop_kernel

blockedFindings.summary: connect_android 授权拒绝分支先 vpn.close() 后没有停存活子进程
blockedFindings.fix: 改为先 stop_android_rust_kernel 再 vpn.close()
